newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end weaker as stocks ease.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end weaker as stocks ease.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures pared early gains to end slightly lower on Thursday following the cash market in Tokyo, dealers said.
Bulls had dug in their heels early on follow-through buying from an optimistic Bank of Japan "tankan" survey on Wednesday.
Dealers said the afternoon pullback was largely technical.
"The Nikkei came up too fast and the cash market got top heavy," a Japanese commission house dealer said.
September Nikkei futures settled at 20,670 but dealers said the longer-term upward trend was still intact.
As the index failed to close above its previous settlement of 20,765, prices were headed for further consolidation, said some dealers.
But expected firm Japanese industrial output data for May due Friday could lend support.
Economists polled by Reuters forecast increases ranging from 1.2 percent to three percent in May output, compared with a revised month-on-month drop of 0.5 percent in April.
Separately, the key June Taiwan MSCI index rose 2.3 points to 386.9 in moderately active trade.
